studies.Authors: Hu J, Mao Y, White K, Canadian Cancer Registries Epidemiology Research Group
studies.Population: Newly diagnosed histologically confirmed RCC cases and population controls in eight Canadian provinces

sample_size.excerpt: Mailed questionnaires were completed by 1279 (691 male and 588 female) newly diagnosed histologically confirmed RCC cases and 5370 (2696 male and 2674 female) population controls between 1994 and 1997 in eight Canadian provinces. Measurement included information on socioeconomic status, smoking habits, alcohol use, diet, and vitamin or mineral supplements.
